modules.module_title: Prepare for breakdown, routine and preventive maintenance work

pcs.pc_description: Determine the routine maintenance requirements of instrumentation & control system by interpreting manufacturer’s manual, maintenance checklist & schedule, work instructions, etc.
Read maintenance schedule and checklist and plan the time and schedule for conducting the maintenance activities
Arrange tools, consumables, spare parts, etc. required for performing repair & maintenance
Clear the work area thoroughly to ensure no unwanted materials are present before starting the work
Ensure that instrumentation and control system is not connected with the equipment or any power source before starting maintenance work
Adhere to all safety norms (such as wearing protective gloves, shoes, etc.) in accordance with the international/ national and organisational standards
Check for ESD symbol on electronic instrumentation and accordingly use ESD protection devices to avoid damage
Inform all affected parties including authorities/ process supervisors of the intended work plan prior to disconnecting power supply line

modules.module_title: Perform breakdown, routine and preventive maintenance activities

pcs.pc_description: Perform basic check-up of instruments, sensors, controllers etc. as specified in the manufacturer manual
Carry out the maintenance activities on a range of instrumentation and control equipment, following the appropriate techniques and procedures
Check the technical and mechanical systems to ensure their operation within the specified parameters
Conduct instrumentation evaluation for hydraulic, pneumatic, mechanical, electrical and electronic measuring & control equipment
Identify the type of faults, required tools and devices for removal of faults
Isolate the faulty part and repair or replace it as per requirement and by following correct procedures
Dismantle the equipment and replace/change or rectify the instrumentation / electrical system
Use spare parts and consumables of equipment as per manufacturer specification
Check the internal conditions of wiring and other parts etc. to test its working status and expected conditions

Conduct breakdown maintenance and then inspect the equipment for leaks, short circuit in parts, breakage of wires and clamps, vibrations, erratic/problematic performance or any other problem as reported in the complain
Conduct the appropriate tests related to the functional performance of instruments, as required
Carry out troubleshooting for test failures to determine root causes and develop processes to avoid repeat failure
Use the appropriate scientific and analytic computer software, calculators, electronic probes, voltage and current meters to diagnose faults in circuitry
Coordinate with the Process supervisor / relevant personnel to evaluate the functioning of instruments and equipment
Use the relevant testing devices for instrumentation to measure & control pressure, flow, temperature, level, motion, force, and chemical makeup
Perform adjustment/ calibration/part replacement/ instrument replacement as specified
Coordinate with Process engineers or process technicians to resolve the issues requiring their assistance
Recommission the instrumentation system appropriately, to return it to service, following repair & replacement activities
Clean & tighten the terminals, screws, clamps and cables and ensure that they are free from dirt, filth, soot and corrosion by following the instructions given in manufacturer manual
Assess when the problem is beyond Technician’s competence and report it to supervisor/ relevant authority
Assemble back the equipment and prepare it for conducting the trials
Leave the work area in clean and tidy condition after the completion of work
Dispose off waste materials such as failed parts/aggregates, as per organisation’s and environmental policies
Record / document all repairs carried out, time taken and other significant findings observed during the work process
Ensure that all maintenance activities are adequately addressed
